summary: NEEDS_RECONCILE: the exact bundle, source mappings, observed billing and delivery pages, and baseline conflict C-501 reconcile, but the candidate installs publishing-only wiki:kit commands into a downstream workflow whose package exposes no wiki:kit script.
evidence: Recomputed the full-index candidate diff digest and every bundled file digest, regenerated the review bundle independently, and obtained the same exact HEAD d5f3087e0312d85dc8e419bd1f02ae2921a06310, merge base 45d4bd6fb8dccfb2c7f43546950ba66573dc6179, and bundle digest bf7b650276af60b386417770cf932cf9b8281a179d3122d0adda47b196e6b03b.

Read the complete bundle contract, metadata, impact, affected pages, source declarations, open conflict C-501, candidate/base primary sources, installed agent entrypoint, package scripts, coverage, source/conflict maps, verification state, workflows, hooks, schema, and downstream development workflow.

Confirmed from both merge base and reviewed HEAD that src/delivery/send.ts returns accepted while src/delivery/contract.ts declares queued, and that the candidate changes neither source; C-501 records origin baseline, type implementation, product/delivery scope, both sources, owner, and an objective resolution criterion.
Passed wiki:generated --check, wiki:lint, wiki:doctor, wiki:audit, wiki:check, metadata-enforced wiki:impact against the exact base, typecheck, and the complete 114-test suite with 516 assertions.
Ran the candidate's documented bun run wiki:kit -- --check command and reproduced error: Script not found "wiki:kit"; package.json contains no wiki:kit script.

findings.discrepancy: The delivery implementation returns accepted while its adjacent intended-status contract declares queued.
evidence: Both values are present at merge base 45d4bd6fb8dccfb2c7f43546950ba66573dc6179 and remain byte-identical at the reviewed HEAD.
wiki/conflicts/open/C-501.md is open, declares conflict_type implementation and origin baseline, affects product/delivery, names both primary sources, and the metadata introduces C-501.
acceptance_criteria: An owner selects accepted or queued and implementation, contract, current page, and tests agree.

findings.discrepancy: The candidate adds a downstream Before a PR contract that requires bun run wiki:kit and bun run wiki:kit -- --check, but the same candidate's package.json defines no wiki:kit script, so adopters cannot execute the declared workflow.
evidence: wiki/WORKFLOW.md lists both wiki:kit commands in its mandatory Before a PR command block.
package.json contains wiki commands for audit, check, conflicts, context, doctor, generated, impact, index, inventory, lint, review, search, verify, and work, but no wiki:kit.
Running bun run wiki:kit -- --check at exact reviewed HEAD d5f3087e0312d85dc8e419bd1f02ae2921a06310 exits 1 with Script not found "wiki:kit".
acceptance_criteria: The downstream Before a PR workflow names only commands that the adopted package actually exposes and supports under its non-publisher configuration.
Running the reconciled documented gate sequence reaches the implemented deterministic checks without a missing-script failure.
Publisher and generated-kit regression coverage prevents publishing-only wiki:kit commands from reappearing in an adopter workflow, and the pilot bundle is regenerated for the reconciled exact HEAD.
